titulo_it: Mi ha chiesto se fossi libero

rispondere.consejo: Regular verb of the second conjugation.

texto: «Vieni?» → **Mi ha chiesto se venivo** / **Mi ha chiesto se venissi** (asked me if I was coming / coming). It is introduced with **se**.
«Dove abiti?» → **Mi ha chiesto dove abitavo** (asked me where I lived). «A che ora parte?» → **Mi ha chiesto a che ora partisse** (asked me what time I was leaving).

filas: Mi ha chiesto se fossi libero.
He asked me if I was free.
He asked me where I was going.
Mi ha chiesto se avevo tempo.
He asked me if I had time.
Mi ha chiesto a che ora partissi.
He asked me what time I was leaving.

frases.es: Me encontré a Marco por la calle.
frases.en: I met Marco on the street.
Oh, yeah? What did he want?

frases.it: Mi ha chiesto se fossi libera sabato sera.
frases.es: Me preguntó si estaba libre el sábado por la tarde.
frases.en: He asked me if I was free on Saturday afternoon.

frases.it: E tu che cosa hai risposto?
Ho risposto che andavo a teatro con un'amica.
frases.es: Respondí que iba al teatro con una amiga.
frases.en: I said I was going to the theater with a friend.
analisis: I was going to the theater.

bloques.pregunta: How do you introduce an indirect yes / no answer question?

opciones.explicacion: «Mi ha chiesto se fossi libero» (asked me if I was free).

bloques.frase: Ieri sera Marco mi ___ se avevo tempo per parlare di lavoro.

opciones.explicacion: Passato prossimo del verbo «chiedere» como introductor interrogativo indirectiva.
«Sapere» denotes knowledge or finds out about something.

bloques.pregunta: What kind of indirect question does he ask?
bloques.frase: Mi ha chiesto dove abitavo durante l'anno universitario.

opciones.texto: A question with question pronoun of place («dove») without graphic questioning.
opciones.explicacion: It retains the «dove» nexus and adapts the verb to the imperfect sign.

opciones.texto: A closed question of whether or not that requires the «se» conjunction.
opciones.explicacion: It's not a question of whether or not it's a question of space location.

opciones.texto: A mandatory order to rent a new apartment.
opciones.explicacion: It reports an inquiry, not a peremptory requirement.

bloques.pregunta: Why does Anna use «libera» in feminine?
bloques.frase: Mi ha chiesto se fossi libera sabato sera.

opciones.texto: Because it matches in gender with Anna, who is the person the question was addressed to.
opciones.explicacion: The predicative is in line with the subject of the subordinate referred to.

opciones.texto: Porque concuerda con el sustantivo masculino «sabato».
opciones.explicacion: If I agreed with sabato, I'd end up in masculine «libero».

opciones.texto: Because all adjectives after «chiedere» end up in -a.
opciones.explicacion: It responds to the natural gender of the speaker.

bloques.frase: Mi ha chiesto se fossi libero per la cena di venerdì
bloques.traduccion: He asked me if I was free for Friday dinner.

bloques.pregunta: Do you have any questions in Italian?

opciones.texto: No, he never carries any question marks as a subordinate proposition.
opciones.explicacion: It ends in an ordinary point as any enunciative prayer.

opciones.texto: Yeah, it always carries a question mark at the beginning and end.
opciones.explicacion: In Italian, the opening sign is never used (is it) and in indirect, it is not being questioned.

opciones.texto: It only takes question if the main verb is present.
opciones.explicacion: Indirect ones systematically dispense with the question mark.

bloques.frase: La professoressa mi ha chiesto a che ora ___ il treno per Firenze.

opciones.explicacion: «partire»'s imperfect congiuntive in indirect question care record.

intro: To report a question, «chiedere se» is used when it is of itself or not, or «chiedere» with the question (dove, eat, quando). In the subordinate, the congiuntive is often used in a careful tone, or the indicative in a regular language.
